races.name: Celebrating Devon Women In Business Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A case can be made for each of these previous course winners. DEPALMA has the scope for most improvement, though, and may get the better of the in-form Limerick Leader on this occasion.

  1. DEPALMA (IRE)
  2. LIMERICK LEADER (FR)
  3. MUSKERRY ROCK (IRE)

races.name: Jodie Standing's Point-To-Point Recruits Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MATIWO stands out on form and is fancied to make a winning return at the expense of Ride Like A Girl and Scott's Legacy.

  1. MATIWO (FR)
  2. RIDE LIKE A GIRL (FR)
  3. SCOTT'S LEGACY (IRE)

races.name: Shelley Coles - Setting the Pace at 60 Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The switch to fences may see an improved effort from lightly-raced MINELLA JURY, who showed plenty of promise in the early part of last season and returns with his yard bang in form. A compelling case can be made for each of the others, with Juggernaut perhaps the most likely danger following a comfortable success over C&D last time.

  1. MINELLA JURY (IRE)
  2. JUGGERNAUT (FR)
  3. INSIDE MAN (FR)

races.name: Final Furlong Before 'I Do' Selling Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The Twiston-Davies team have had a few horses win on reappearance in recent days and LIGHTNING FLASH could well be another. Berry Edge is feared most on second start for Dan Skelton.

  1. LIGHTNING FLASH (IRE)
  2. BERRY EDGE (IRE)
  3. SAUCATS (FR)

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Unexposed KILNEW SUPREME ought to get off the mark if ready to roll. Kom Tu Voudras could be the one to follow him home.

  1. KILNEW SUPREME (IRE)
  2. KOM TU VOUDRAS (FR)
  3. KITTYS GLANCE

races.name: Par Inn Bulpin Cup Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
POOROLDMACKLEY has been shaping up well under his regular amateur rider and looks capable of getting off the mark for the year. Bits Ballou, Ask Peter and Poet's Muse appeal most of the remainder.

  1. POOROLDMACKLEY (IRE)
  2. BITS BALLOU
  3. ASK PETER (FR)

races.name: Clearwater DC Ltd Environmental Solutions Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
ANNIE EDSON TAYLOR has rediscovered her form over C&D on softer ground and is taken to record the hat-trick. Punchbowl Flyer and Maldevious head up the dangers.

  1. ANNIE EDSON TAYLOR
  2. PUNCHBOWL FLYER (IRE)
  3. MALDEVIOUS (IRE)

races.name: Moira Stein Memorial EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CYBERSPACE is likely to step up again after his second at Redcar and this looks a good opportunity. Youngheartsrunfree is the other potential improver in the field so is second choice.

  1. CYBERSPACE
  2. YOUNGHEARTSRUNFREE (IRE)
  3. KOMPOZITOR

races.name: Rotary Club East Kilbride Nursery Selling Handicap
races.verdict:
FERN CLYDE is the only previous winner in the field and can double her tally at the expense of Or Another, who should appreciate the drop back in trip.

  1. FERN CLYDE
  2. OR ANOTHER (IRE)
  3. DADAWADA (IRE)

races.name: John MacKenzie And Hamish MacGregor Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
LIR SPECIALE has been running well all summer so this could be his day with conditions now in his favour. This does look very competitive, though, with penalised-winner Good Morning Alex and class-dropper El Matador heading the dangers.

  1. LIR SPECIALE (IRE)
  2. GOOD MORNING ALEX
  3. EL MATADOR (IRE)

races.name: Barbara Ann Letham And Son Johnathan Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
CITY CAPTAIN took his form to another level when narrowly failing to land a gamble here last week so looks the one to beat off the same mark. Francisco's Piece is next best after his eye-catching run in the Ayr Bronze Cup, while Topwarrior offered a bit more in this headgear at Doncaster last time and is back on a winning mark.

  1. CITY CAPTAIN
  2. FRANCISCO'S PIECE
  3. TOPWARRIOR

races.name: Phoenix Drilling Ground Investigation Handicap
races.verdict:
IMPRESSOR landed a bit of a touch in the mud over C&D 8 days ago and remaining well treated on old form carrying a 4-lb penalty, Phillip Makin's veteran gets the vote to follow up. Vince l'Amour has never been one for maximum faith, but he can provide most resistance if on a going day, with Supremissy, who finished close behind the selection last time, rounding off the shortlist.

  1. IMPRESSOR (IRE)
  2. VINCE L'AMOUR (IRE)
  3. SUPREMISSY (IRE)

races.name: Annual Members Of Hamilton Park Handicap
races.verdict:
It's hard to have much faith in a 21-race maiden but OFF SPIN has been knocking at the door this season and having shaped better than the bare result at Ayr recently, he's afforded the tentative vote. Jim Goldie looks to have a strong hand with Uncle Liam and Storm on Jura so they're feared most, with Hickton another to consider from a much-reduced mark, as well.

  1. OFF SPIN (IRE)
  2. UNCLE LIAM (IRE)
  3. STORM ON JURA

races.name: Matchbook SignUp - Get 20% Back On Losses Handicap
races.verdict:
It could be worth siding with HARRY BROWN to bounce back in style off a lenient-looking mark now dropped in grade. Recent Windsor scorer Roman Spring rates the obvious threat ahead of Bated Breeze and Beach Partee.

  1. HARRY BROWN
  2. ROMAN SPRING (IRE)
  3. BATED BREEZE (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not the easiest maiden to assess and it could be worth siding with James Tate's well-related Starman filly GALILEO STAR to make a winning debut, especially if the market vibes are positive. Form pick River Nile could have a big say though if shrugging off a lesser effort at Pontefract, while Poor Relation is not out of things either.

  1. GALILEO STAR
  2. RIVER NILE (IRE)
  3. POOR RELATION (FR)

races.name: Follow Matchbook On X Nursery
races.verdict:
Not as competitive as the numbers suggest. MAGICAL LIFE rates just the pick of the weights and is taken to double her tally at the chief expense of Wild Orchid who comes here on the back of an improved Yarmouth fourth on her nursery debut. Beach Ahead and Allaboutthelunch can also have a say.

  1. MAGICAL LIFE
  2. WILD ORCHID
  3. BEACH AHEAD

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 40 Pound In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
races.verdict:
NEWFANGLED rates just the pick of the weights and captured this prize 12 months ago so edges the vote from hat-trick seeking Danehill Star. Hamda's Joy and Gone Rogue also need factoring into this wide-open handicap.

  1. NEWFANGLED (IRE)
  2. DANEHILL STAR (IRE)
  3. HAMDA'S JOY (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Monthly Bet-Builder Rebate Handicap
races.verdict:
None of these can be ruled out but the vote goes to DARKEST RED who arrives on the back of a very good Epsom second and can go well again nudged up 2 lb. Miss Guinevere rates a big threat though now she steps up to this trip for the first time, while last year's victor Love You Back also commands plenty of respect.

  1. DARKEST RED
  2. MISS GUINEVERE (IRE)
  3. LOVE YOU BACK (IRE)

races.name: Play Your Multiples At matchbook.com Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but ROYAL COUNTY GLORY has looked a different model since joining Jack Jones and is fancied to make light of a 3 lb rise for his most recent Lingfield victory and complete a hat-trick. Course winner Campani also bids for a third success of 2026 and seems sure to be on the premises, while Shes Got The Blues and King David, who came home 1-2 here recently, are also well in the mix.

  1. ROYAL COUNTY GLORY (IRE)
  2. CAMPANI
  3. SHES GOT THE BLUES (IRE)

races.name: Download The Matchbook Exchange App Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
MACANUDO has been firmly in the groove since the blinkers went back on and is fancied to defy a 3 lb rise and gain a quick hat-trick here at the chief expense of the consistent My Mate Mackley who looks set to extend his run of solid in-frame efforts. In-form duo Port Hedland and Nordic Glory can also play a prominent role in this very open-looking handicap.

  1. MACANUDO (IRE)
  2. MY MATE MACKLEY
  3. PORT HEDLAND

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
BALOO'S BLUES has had a solid campaign and is taken to go one better than over C&D a fortnight ago. Little She went close to a breakthrough success at Lingfield 4 weeks ago and is second choice ahead of Star Start, who was well held last time but has a good overall record under today's rider Charli Parker.

  1. BALOO'S BLUES
  2. LITTLE SHE (FR)
  3. STAR START (IRE)

races.name: Download The At The Races App Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A good novice. NAJIDI STORM may have simply got stuck in the mud at Goodwood and has to be worth another chance given how promising his all-weather debut success was. Wootz also looks decidedly useful and is feared most ahead of Shadow Boxer, who has been off since his promising debut third in the spring.

  1. NAJIDI STORM
  2. WOOTZ (IRE)
  3. SHADOW BOXER (FR)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On Instagram EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MAJESTIC FLAME had a possible excuse last time and is given a second chance to confirm her debut promise. Last-time-out C&D second Speed Nation is the obvious danger on form. Ambience is worth a look in the betting back from a breathing operation.

  1. MAJESTIC FLAME
  2. SPEED NATION (IRE)
  3. AMBIENCE

races.name: Cavani Style & Speed Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Perhaps best to narrow this down to the 3-y-os, with Oisin Murphy's mount RIDGER preferered to Escape Magic. Recent C&D runner-up Mintana may prove best of the older brigade assuming her wide stall isn't too troublesome.

  1. RIDGER (IRE)
  2. ESCAPE MAGIC
  3. MINTANA

races.name: Cavani Style & Speed Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
BUNGLE BAY is one of few who obviously arrives in decent form and might be good for a sixth C&D success. Tilsworth Max has saved his best all-weather form to date for Lingfield's polytrack but he will be a threat if close to the form he showed when runner-up there 18 days ago. Sanditon also has a bit of class for this grade if back on his game.

  1. BUNGLE BAY (IRE)
  2. TILSWORTH MAX
  3. SANDITON (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
races.verdict:
ZAFAAN does have to prove his stamina for this far on the Flat but arrives on the back of a recent hurdle win and has the services of Billy Loughnane. Trojan Truth makes life awkward for himself with his slow starts but has a bit of class for this grade and is second choice ahead of Wonderful Wendy.

  1. ZAFAAN (IRE)
  2. TROJAN TRUTH
  3. WONDERFUL WENDY

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
CROWN THE FUTURE has already won here and looks the most solid option after his good second over C&D last time. Ernie McCrew was a place behind the selection on that occasion and has won at Lingfield since. Wild Rosie and Oisin Murphy's mount Roserunner also make the shortlist.

  1. CROWN THE FUTURE (IRE)
  2. ERNIE MCCREW (IRE)
  3. WILD ROSIE

races.name: Cavani Winning Form Handicap
races.verdict:
A tight handicap. Given it was only his second outing of the year BONA FORTUNA might be able to build on his last Brighton second. Too Darn Good won in taking fashion over C&D 3 weeks ago and is feared most ahead of Nogo's Dream, who is quirky but is down to his lowest mark for a long time.

  1. BONA FORTUNA (IRE)
  2. TOO DARN GOOD (IRE)
  3. NOGO'S DREAM

races.name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap
races.verdict:
THE ANTHONY GOVER escapes a penalty for last week's win and is taken to overcome the outside stall and land a C&D hat-trick. Pipily is another with good recent C&D form and is second choice ahead of Vega Storm and Variety Act.

  1. THE ANTHONY GOVER
  2. PIPILY
  3. VEGA STORM (IRE)

races.name: Molson Coors Beverage Company Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
PREMIER VIEW proved transformed on the back of being gelded and being fitted with a tongue tie when going in over C&D earlier this month and can follow up now quickly pitched into nursery company off a handy-looking mark. Naas scorer Santo Parvenue rates the obvious threat despite taking an 8 lb hike, while Invincible Irish can also have a say.

  1. PREMIER VIEW (IRE)
  2. SANTO PARVENUE (IRE)
  3. INVINCIBLE IRISH (IRE)

races.name: Coors Fillies Handicap
races.verdict:
A case can be made for a few but NELLCOTE has improved a chunk with each of her 3 runs and is fancied to quickly resume winning ways after an excellent second on her handicap bow at the Curragh. Stellar Moment is another filly on an upward curve and she can also go well on the back of her own improved handicap showing when runner-up at Roscommon. C&D scorer Navy Waters is weighted to go well too, while the reliable Lady Plimsoll is another to enter calculations in this cracking handicap.

  1. NELLCOTE (IRE)
  2. STELLAR MOMENT (IRE)
  3. NAVY WATERS (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
STAR GLORY bounced back to form when second at Naas last month and can give Noel Meade a third win in 5 runnings in this fillies maiden. Ladrona is an appealing newcomer, while Essence of Time and Hip Hop Chrissy could have races in them.

  1. STAR GLORY (IRE)
  2. LADRONA (IRE)
  3. ESSENCE OF TIME

races.name: Madri Excepcional Maiden
races.verdict:
DARING HEART has been seen just twice in 13 months but clearly has stacks of ability and could be the one to beat if taking another step forward in a first-time tongue tie. Keogie and Aidan O'Brien's Monmouth are dangers.

  1. DARING HEART (IRE)
  2. KEOGIE (IRE)
  3. MONMOUTH (IRE)

races.name: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
races.verdict:
UNA MATATA is well handicapped if building on a more encouraging run at Dundalk and is worth chancing. 2024-winner Alex Belardo can go well returning to Down Royal and looks a player, while Send Harry is another to consider having bounced back to form when second in front of the selection at Dundalk.

  1. UNA MATATA (IRE)
  2. ALEX BELARDO (IRE)
  3. SEND HARRY (IRE)

races.name: Pravha Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
CHLOE'S BOY has few miles on the clock and can follow up from last time. No More Hiding and Tassarolo look the main dangers in this low-grade handicap.

  1. CHLOE'S BOY (IRE)
  2. NO MORE HIDING
  3. TASSAROLO

races.name: Pravha Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
AUGUSTA ROCK has shown enough previously to be competitive at this level and can open his account. Ballaghkeen caught the eye on her reappearance at Navan and can step up on that, with Flagstone Lady another to consider on the back of her recent course success.

  1. AUGUSTA ROCK (IRE)
  2. BALLAGHKEEN (IRE)
  3. FLAGSTONE LADY (IRE)

races.name: Molson Coors Beverage Handicap
races.verdict:
RAKKI stepped up on his reappearance to open his account on the level at Tramore just over 6 weeks ago and far from handicapped out of things from 4 lb higher, Willie Mullins' 5-y-o gets the verdict to follow up. Flying Fortress is knocking at the door so he can provide most resistance, with Nod of Approval and Sarangpur another couple worthy of consideration, too.

  1. RAKKI
  2. FLYING FORTRESS
  3. NOD OF APPROVAL (IRE)

races.name: Athleague Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Following a promising hurdling debut, TELEGRAM SAM ought to be capable of winning a race of this nature. Direct Approach could have a big say if headgear has the desired effect, with Henry de Bromhead's Sonas another likely type.

  1. TELEGRAM SAM (IRE)
  2. DIRECT APPROACH (IRE)
  3. SONAS (IRE)

races.name: Gary's Gardening Services Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
Preference is for COOL SUMMER, who has seen the form of her success at Wexford boosted by the fifth winning next time. She can continue her progress to score again, though Colesberg is also open to further improvement after his third on handicap debut at Tramore. Another Blunder completes the shortlist.

  1. COOL SUMMER (IRE)
  2. COLESBERG (IRE)
  3. ANOTHER BLUNDER (IRE)

races.name: Kelly Hearing Specialists Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
KIMI DE MAI looks the most likely winner, while acknowledging that she has been expensive to follow in similar events. Wicked Pleasure appeals as the main danger, with fellow hurdling debutants Born Believing and Culldoo also respected. Brave Lady is the pick of the remainder with hurdles experience.

  1. KIMI DE MAI (FR)
  2. WICKED PLEASURE (IRE)
  3. BRAVE LADY (IRE)

races.name: Railway Bar Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
A mightily difficult puzzle with several potentially ahead of their marks. DUCE BIGALOW gets the nod in his bid to make it 2-2 for his present yard. Bruise Hill and Ardgillan are both feared, especially as the pace has the potential to be strong. Ancient Myth completes the shortlist.

  1. DUCE BIGALOW (IRE)
  2. BRUISE HILL (IRE)
  3. ARDGILLAN (IRE)

races.name: Castlecoote Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SMALLCRAFTWARNING did well to finish in the frame having come from further back than the other principals at Listowel last week and now racing back from his 'proper mark' John Ryan's 9-y-o gets the verdict to regain the winning thread. Watching The Clock heads up the dangers having gone close at Wexford back in the spring, with West Is Awake and Roc My Haarth another couple worth considering, too.

  1. SMALLCRAFTWARNING (IRE)
  2. WATCHING THE CLOCK (IRE)
  3. WEST IS AWAKE (IRE)

races.name: Ballymore Group Irish EBF Kilbegnet Novice Chase (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
A Grade 3 winner over hurdles, DADDY LONG LEGS jumped well in the main when making a successful chasing debut in good style at Killarney and he looks to hold leading claims with progress to come. C&D winner Wild Bill Hickok is better than he could show last time and is the pick for second, ahead of Femme Magnifique.

  1. DADDY LONG LEGS (FR)
  2. WILD BILL HICKOK (IRE)
  3. FEMME MAGNIFIQUE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
LADIES WELL has shown improved form sent chasing this season, landing 2 handicaps and continuing in good heart when never-nearer fourth at Ballinrobe 17 days ago. She is taken to resume winning ways, at the expense of the in-form Chosen Shant and handicap-debutant Jolie Jewel.

  1. LADIES WELL (IRE)
  2. CHOSEN SHANT (IRE)
  3. JOLIE JEWEL (FR)

races.name: GavinLynchRacing.com Flat Race
races.verdict:
A half-sister to a useful hurdler, DR BONES makes plenty of appeal and she could be up to becoming another winning bumper debutant for her powerful stable. She gets the vote ahead of fellow newcomer Finest Band, while Touch The Clouds is worth another chance to build on his debut promise.

  1. DR BONES (IRE)
  2. TOUCH THE CLOUDS (IRE)
  3. FINEST BAND (FR)
